# Three.js 0.186.1

The two JavaScript modules are unmodified files from the installed `three`
package, version **0.186.1**, distributed under the MIT license. The full notice
is retained in [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt).

- Upstream: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
- Version source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/three/v/0.186.1
- Files: `build/three.module.js` and `build/three.core.js`.

The portfolio loads these local modules only when the 3D demo starts. No CDN,
package installation, build, existing badge model, or external runtime service
is needed. The actual badge renderer and local-model provenance are documented in
`docs/portfolio/HYB26-MODEL.md`; its asset rights are separate from this license.
